## Experience
### Shoutt
**Full-Stack Engineer** | Nov 2025 - Present
London, United Kingdom
- jumped in as the first engineering hire right after a $700k seed round, spearheading the technical roadmap and shipping full-stack features to scale the platform.
- built our own scraping engine that pulls in 60k+ jobs a week, so we didn't have to rely on a paid vendor, saving ~£20k a year.
- cut our AI bill by $37k a year by switching to smaller, cheaper decision models that make 60% fewer mistakes, even with 11× more jobs coming through.
- automated 35+ hours a week of copy-paste work, about one full-time person's job.
- redesigned the main feed into a two-pane layout after users told us long lists were tiring to scroll. engagement up 35% for 12,000+ monthly users.
- built a retention modal that cut churn by 22% and boosted downgrade conversions by 18%. every user matters.
- got an AI classifier from 70% to 93% accuracy by making it think step by step, tested against 1,000+ real past records.

### SJ Telford
**Backend .NET Cloud Developer** | Jun 2025 - Nov 2025
London, United Kingdom
- built a new serverless .net 8 API from the ground up on azure functions, designed to handle over 12,000 concurrent players for 20+ games.
- wrote a ton of tests (using xunit and moq) to take the project from 0% to over 95% test coverage, which let us finally build a stable CI/CD pipeline.
- was obsessed with performance, so i wrote a complete load testing strategy with k6 to make sure the API stayed fast (under 500ms) and didn't crash, even under real-world, production-scale traffic.
- fixed a nasty cold-start problem in azure functions by building a hybrid L1/L2 cache, which cut initial response times by over 85%.
- wrote custom middleware to handle API key auth, securing 100% of the data endpoints and stopping bad requests right at the start.
- figured out a novel way to test .NET 8 middleware when the framework itself had a limitation, allowing us to unit test 100% of our critical authentication logic (which was impossible before).
